_format: Each case: what was said, and the expected plan. Plan items: ["open", app], ["click"|"dblclick"|"rightclick", target], ["fill", target, value], ["press", keys], ["scroll", direction, area], ["ask", claim], ["stop"], ["unknown"]. A string may be a list of acceptable answers. Compared case-insensitively, ignoring a leading 'the', trailing punctuation and a trailing '?'. "*" accepts any value (for example the field when none was named). Cases marked "real" come from a live voice session (Whisper transcripts, including its mishearings).
